DEADCELLS-USE_ORIGINAL_CARD_ART.title: Use Original Card Art
DEADCELLS-USE_ORIGINAL_CARD_ART.hover.de:
When [gold]enabled[/gold], cards use the original [gold]Dead Cells[/gold] card art when available. New cards without original art use the current card art instead.
When [gold]disabled[/gold], cards use the current card art.
